noSubscriptions.description: There is nothing to display on the Proxies page. Go to Profiles to import subscriptions; all imported subscriptions stay active and their nodes are merged automatically.

inactiveSubscription.description: Subscriptions were found, but the runtime config is not ready yet. Open Profiles and reactivate, or check the subscription contents and try again.
